# Witness the menu hover and keyboard paths that already work

## Context

The operator asked for more tests of menu hover and keyboard navigation, submenus included (2026-09-18). Scratch Playwright arms against `dev@3f859a4803` measured the paths below as **correct today**. None has an arm. @neo-opus-ada, who built the menu stack, cross-checked each gap by grepping `component/menu`, `unit/menu` and `component/button/Base.spec.mjs`. The defects the same probes found are filed separately.

| # | path | measured |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Arrowing past a parent faster than `subMenuHoverDelay` | never previews (maximum levels observed: 1), while resting on it previews (2). This is the debounce contract of the focus rest (#18780) |
| 2 | Arrow keys over a disabled row and a separator | skipped both ways |
| 3 | A pointer rest on a disabled parent | previews nothing |
| 4 | Hover to depth 3, then a rest on a root leaf | the whole branch goes in one step: level counts `[3, 1]` |
| 5 | A click on a leaf inside a hover preview that focus never entered | every level closes, and the item's `route` fires exactly once |
| 6 | Enter on a leaf two levels down | every level closes together (`[3, 0]`), and the route fires once |
| 7 | Escape from depth 3 | walks back one level per press, focusing each parent item, then dismisses |
| 8 | Arrowing inside a submenu | previews and drops that submenu's own child level, never closing itself |
| 9 | Tab out of a submenu | dismisses the whole floating cascade |
| 10 | The pointer leaving the menu while a preview shows | the preview stays |
| 11 | A press on dead space in a `form.field.ComboBox`'s bound list (added after #18854, at @neo-opus-vega's review note) | the input keeps focus. This is the one Navigator consumer whose focus lives outside the subject, so the walk's `subject.parentNode` limit is what the arm witnesses |

## The Problem

The 09-16 stack (#18758 → #18804) pinned what it changed. Everything above works because of how those pieces compose, and a regression in any of them would ship green. Row 1 is the most exposed: the focus-rest arms use `subMenuHoverDelay` 0 or 1000, never a pass-through faster than the delay.

## The Architectural Reality

- The fixtures already exist in `test/playwright/component/menu/List.spec.mjs`: `createMenu(page, config)`, the three-level `items` tree, `restItems`, `recordLevelCounts` / `levelCounts` and `focusedItem`. A route on a leaf gives an exactly-once witness: count `hashchange` events, because `Neo.Main.setRoute` writes `location.hash`.
- Absence needs a bounded wait before it is read, the way the existing arms "outlast the delay". Presence polls.

## The Fix

Add one arm per row to `test/playwright/component/menu/List.spec.mjs`, reusing its fixtures. It is a test-only change.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Rows 1–11 each have an arm, green on `dev` (row 11 once #18854 is on `dev`, which it is).
- [ ] Rows 1 and 4 each fail under a one-line source mutation that breaks the behaviour they claim, recorded in the PR:
  - row 1: `startRest` ignores `subMenuHoverDelay`
  - row 4: a level's `unmount()` stops hiding its own submenu

  Row 3 has two independent guards, the row's `pointer-events: none` and the hover delegate's `nonInteractiveItemCls` check, so no single mutation reddens it. The PR says so rather than claiming one.
- [ ] No arm asserts a process-global or timing-sensitive count, and each absence is read after a bounded wait.

## Out of Scope

- Touch or pen "rest" and RTL arrow semantics, which are design questions first (Ada's gaps 5 and 6).
- The End / skipped-row-click defect (#18846) and the focus hand-back defect (#18847).
